arStrings.szText: Each time you Cast {c_important}Tornado{/c}, there is a {c_number}[{SF_17}*100|%|]{/c} chance to spawn an additional {c_important}Tornado{/c}.

Extend the lifetime of {c_important}Tornado{/c} by {c_number}[SF_18]{/c} seconds. Additionally, hitting a {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemy extends the duration further by {c_number}[SF_19|1|]{/c} seconds up to a maximum of {c_number}[SF_20]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Tornado{/c} Slows enemies hit by {c_number}[SF_22*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_23]{/c} seconds.
